execution_gate: Do not interpret propagated closure fidelity until independent future-response state sufficiency is available. One-step teacher-forced closure diagnostics may execute earlier because they do not select state dimension.

sign_convention.requirement: all candidate closures must reproduce identical zero-gradient and hydrostatic sign/limit tests before trajectory use

C_DARCY_CENTER_HARMONIC.authority: new research-only finite-volume comparator; equation frozen here before execution
C_DARCY_CENTER_HARMONIC.distinction_from_standard_lare: same state and pressure-head gradient; only interface hydraulic resistance/conductivity averaging changes

requirement_before_execution: unique within-layer profile reconstruction for the declared boundary class
persisted root/branch choice for any nonlinear solve
limit identity to C_DARCY_CENTER_HARMONIC for uniform reconstructed profiles

C_REFERENCE_FACE_ORACLE.state: frozen reduced state plus face flux sampled from fine Reference

quantities: interlayer flux at every reduced interface
bottom flux where the exact boundary class has closure authority
distance from Reference fine-grid face flux
one_step_closure_diagnostics.purpose: separate algebraic closure error from accumulated state error

propagated_comparison.same_partition_corichards: required where numerically qualified before attributing residual error uniquely to closure

falsification: A closure that violates exact mass telescoping, finite-state constraints, or sign/limit identities is rejected before fidelity comparison.
If C_DARCY_CENTER_HARMONIC changes little relative to C_LARE_TAYLOR while both disagree strongly with Reference, conductivity averaging is not the dominant closure deficit.
If teacher-forced Reference face flux removes most propagated error for the same reduced state, closure/flux law rather than state dimension is implicated.
If same-partition CoRichards already differs materially from R16, do not classify the corresponding component as Layer-ROM closure error.
No empirical correction term is admitted in Phase A.
